import csv, os, xlrd
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
src='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'
outdir='staging_mirna'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
s=xlrd.open_workbook(src).sheet_by_index(0)
samples=[str(s.cell_value(1,j)).strip() for j in range(1,s.ncols)]
mirnas=[str(s.cell_value(i,0)).strip() for i in range(2,s.nrows)]
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'data_matrix.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['sample']+mirnas)
    for j,sample in enumerate(samples,1):
        vals=[]
        for i in range(2,s.nrows):
            v=s.cell_value(i,j)
            vals.append('NA' if isinstance(v,str) and v.strip().upper()=='NAN' else repr(v) if isinstance(v,float) else str(v))
        w.writerow([sample]+vals)
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'sample_metadata.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['sample','group'])
    for sample in samples:
        w.writerow([sample,'Patient' if sample.startswith('P_') else 'Control'])
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'variable_metadata.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['miRNA','miRNA_name'])
    for mirna in mirnas:
        w.writerow([mirna,mirna])
with open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']) as f: key=f.read().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
hid='bbd44e69cb8906b5863eefd5b3517396'
for fn in ['data_matrix.tsv','sample_metadata.tsv','variable_metadata.tsv']:
    res=gi.tools.upload_file(os.path.join(outdir,fn),hid,file_name=fn,file_type='tabular')
    jobs=[j.get('id') for j in res.get('jobs',[]) if j.get('id')]
    outs=[o.get('id') for o in res.get('outputs',[]) if o.get('id')]
    print(fn,'datasets',','.join(outs),'jobs',','.join(jobs))
